Competition Level Analysis for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026

The competition level for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 is expected to be moderate to high. The recruitment is restricted to Male candidates only, which reduces the applicant pool compared to open-gender recruitments. However, 899 vacancies across technical/trade posts will attract a large number of ITI-qualified and Matriculation-level candidates, especially for high-vacancy posts like Store Keeper Technical (300) and Operator Communication (261). The written exam followed by PET and Trade Test provides multiple elimination stages, but candidates with relevant ITI trade certificates and physical fitness will have a clear advantage. Ex-Servicemen and Ex-Agniveers get significant age relaxation and weightage, which makes certain trades more competitive in that segment.

The key differentiator here is the offline application process - many eligible candidates may miss out due to postal delays or incorrect application format, effectively reducing actual competition at the written exam stage. Candidates who submit complete and correct applications well before the deadline and prepare trade-specific written exam syllabi will have a significant edge.

Who should NOT apply for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026?

  • Female candidates - this recruitment is strictly for Indian National Males only.
  • Candidates who do not possess the requisite educational/technical qualification as on the closing date of application; those awaiting final exam results are not eligible.
  • Candidates outside the age band 18-27 years as on 01 Jun 2026 (except those eligible for applicable category-based relaxation).
  • OBC candidates from the Creamy Layer - they are not entitled to OBC reservation or age relaxation and must apply as UR/General category.
  • Candidates who cannot meet the region-wise physical standards (height, chest, weight) as physical fitness is mandatory for induction.
  • Candidates with permanent medical conditions listed as grounds for permanent rejection (colour blindness for Drivers/Operators, cardiac conditions, gross myopia, etc.) who cannot pass the Primary Medical Examination at GREF Centre.
  • Candidates unwilling or unable to be posted anywhere in India, especially in remote, high-altitude, or difficult terrain areas in Northern and Eastern regions.
  • Candidates who cannot arrange and send a physical application form with photograph, thumb impression, signature, fee e-receipt, and attested copies by post to Pune - there is no online application mode.
  • Candidates with tattoos on any body part other than the inner forearm (inside elbow to wrist) or reverse palm - tattoos on other parts lead to disqualification at PME.
  • Ex-servicemen who have already joined Govt civil service using ESM benefits and are claiming ESM status again - such candidates are treated as civilian employees.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying BRO GREF Recruitment 2026?

  • Not printing the application form on A4 size 75 GSM bond paper (one side only) and admit card on both sides of a single paper as mandated - non-standard paper leads to rejection.
  • Applying without attaching the e-receipt copy of the application fee paid via SBI Collect; no other payment mode is accepted and missing receipt causes rejection.
  • Sending the application from a wrong/old address instead of present postal address - applications posted from wrong address are rejected to prevent fraudulent claims of 60-day receipt benefit.
  • Not superscribing the envelope with "APPLICATION FOR (NAME OF TRADE/POST) Under Category (UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/ESM/CPL)" as required - unlabelled envelopes may be misdirected.
  • Mismatch between name in application and name in Matriculation certificate - even a dropped or added part of the name requires a Gazette Notification; otherwise candidature is summarily cancelled.
  • Submitting multiple applications for the same post with different details or photographs - this results in lifetime debarment from all GREF examinations.
  • OBC/EWS certificate dated older than one year from the closing date - OBC and EWS certificates must be fresh (not older than one year as on closing date) and in the prescribed Central Govt format.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post/trade using the same envelope - each post requires a separate application with separate fee in a separate envelope.
  • Not carrying the minimum 12 passport-size photographs (same as pasted on application and admit card) to all subsequent recruitment stages - shortage of photos causes disruption at PET/TT/PME stages.
  • Ignoring the trade-specific syllabus and treating the written exam as a general knowledge test - each post has a distinct subject-wise syllabus and candidates must prepare trade-specific topics.

How to Apply for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply offline only; no online application mode is available. Application form and admit card must be downloaded from the official BRO website (www.bro.gov.in) and filled in English or Hindi only, in capital letters. The application form must be printed on A4 size 75 GSM bond paper (one side only) and admit card printed on both sides of a single paper. Candidates must first pay the application fee online via SBI Collect portal and attach the e-receipt copy. Candidates applying for more than one post must send separate applications with separate fee in separate envelopes. Candidates are strongly advised to send applications well before the closing date and not wait for the last day - GREF Centre will not be responsible for postal delays.

Candidates should read the detailed instructions and guidelines available at https://bfsissc.com before applying.

Documents Required to be Enclosed with Application Form:

  • Recent colour passport-size photograph (not older than 1 month from the date of Advertisement) pasted at the prescribed place on application form and admit card - minimum 12 copies of the same photograph to be carried throughout the recruitment process
  • Left hand thumb impression at the prescribed place on application form and admit card
  • Signature of candidate at the prescribed place
  • Copy of e-receipt of application fee paid via SBI Collect
  • Self-attested photostat copies of certificates for essential educational/technical qualifications (Matriculation onwards), date of birth, caste certificate (as per format in Appendix A/B), OBC NCL declaration (Appendix D), EWS certificate (Appendix C), Disability Certificate (Appendix E for PwBD), experience certificate (if applicable), Driving Licence copy (for OEM post)
  • NCC certificate copies (B or C grade), sports certificate, or relationship certificate for Sons of Serving/Ex-GREF personnel - for claiming weightage marks
  • Proof of residence/domicile (for correct physical standards region)
  • Any certificate in language other than Hindi or English must be enclosed with an attested Hindi/English translation by a Group A Gazetted Officer

Send Application (by Postal Service) to: Commandant, GREF Centre, Dighi Camp, Pune - 411015

Printout / physical application is NOT to be sent anywhere else. No hard copy of admit card for written exam will be sent by post - admit card will be posted to the communication address given by the candidate in the admit card.

Application form available at: https://www.bro.gov.in

For queries: Visit https://www.bro.gov.in - all recruitment updates, results, and call letters will be displayed on the BRO website only.

Important Instructions for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Male Indian Nationals can apply; Female candidates are not eligible.
  • Application form and/or admit card without signature, without photograph, or without thumb impression will be summarily rejected - no communication will be done for rejected applications.
  • Candidates must ensure their Aadhaar Card photo is current (not older than 2-3 years from written exam date) and address/phone is updated; outdated Aadhaar may prevent entry to the exam.
  • Son of Serving / Ex-GREF staff should write father's GS No., Rank, and Name on top of the application in red ink with a photocopy of relationship certificate, to claim the 15% weightage benefit.
  • Casual Paid Labours (CPL) of GREF who have worked for 179 days in the last one year and are on the Muster Roll on the date of advertisement publication get 10% additional weightage - attach experience certificate signed by OC unit, countersigned by Commander BRTF and verified by Accounts Officer.
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates who qualify on their own merit (without relaxed standards) will be accommodated against UR vacancies - they must NOT apply separately against UR vacancies.
  • OBC candidates belonging to Creamy Layer are not entitled to reservation; they should apply under UR category.
  • Candidates serving in other Government Departments must apply through proper channel sufficiently in advance; applications not received by due date through proper channel will be rejected.
  • Mobile phones, smartwatches, and all electronic/communication devices are strictly NOT ALLOWED inside GREF Centre, Pune campus during any recruitment process.
  • A candidate who absents himself during any recruitment activity for which he has been called will have his candidature cancelled automatically - he will not be allowed to appear for further stages.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation/re-checking of scores in examination; no correspondence in this regard shall be entertained.
  • Legal jurisdiction for any dispute arising out of this Advertisement shall fall within the jurisdiction of the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi.
  • Impersonation or submission of forged documents leads to debarment from all GREF examinations for life/2 years and legal action. GREF has not appointed any agent or coaching centre for action on its behalf - SELECTION WILL BE DONE PURELY ON MERIT IN A TRANSPARENT MANNER.
  • Vacancies are liable to increase/decrease/cancel at any stage without notice due to unforeseen situations.
  • All revisions/corrigendum will be hosted on the BRO website only - candidates should visit www.bro.gov.in regularly.

BPCL Experienced Professionals Recruitment 2026 - Post-wise Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the cut-off date 01-04-2026. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Relevant post-qualification work experience is mandatory. Qualifications must be from AICTE approved / UGC recognized Universities. All post-wise essential qualifications and work experience details are given below.

1A. Team Member / Team Leader – Exploration (BPRL)

Criteria Details
Essential Educational Qualification B.E. / B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% aggregate (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD) OR Post-Graduate in Geo-sciences (Geology / Applied Geology / Geophysics / Applied Geophysics) with minimum 60% aggregate (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD).
Essential Work Experience (as on 01.04.2026) Minimum 10 years of post-qualification work experience with at least 5 years of cumulative experience in Exploration / Reservoir Management in Exploration & Projects Hydrocarbon sector.

1B. Team Member / Team Leader – Asset Manager (BPRL)

Criteria Details
Essential Educational Qualification B.E. / B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% aggregate (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD). Post Graduate Degree in Engineering or MBA / PGDM or Post Graduate in Geo-Sciences is desirable.
Essential Work Experience (as on 01.04.2026) Minimum 7 years’ work experience with at least 5 years of cumulative experience in production activities / Asset management in Exploration & Projects Hydrocarbon sector.

1C. Team Member – Reservoir Engineer (BPRL)

Criteria Details
Essential Educational Qualification B.E. / B.Tech in Petroleum Engineering / Petroleum Technology / Applied Petroleum Engineering / Chemical Engineering with minimum 60% aggregate (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD).
Essential Work Experience (as on 01.04.2026) Minimum 7 years’ work experience in Upstream Oil & Gas Industry in Reservoir Engineering.

2A. Company Secretary – Team Leader

Criteria Details
Essential Educational Qualification Qualified Company Secretary from the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI). Additional qualification of LLB will be preferred.
Essential Work Experience (as on 01.04.2026) Minimum 18 years of post-qualification experience, of which at least the last 5 years should be in an equity-listed Company in their Company Secretarial set-up with knowledge of Companies Act, SEBI regulations, FEMA Act, Listing Requirements, etc.

2B. Company Secretary – Team Member

Criteria Details
Essential Educational Qualification Qualified Company Secretary from the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI). Additional qualification of LLB will be preferred.
Essential Work Experience (as on 01.04.2026) Minimum 7 years of post-qualification experience, of which at least the last 2 years should be in an equity-listed Company in their Company Secretarial setup with knowledge of Companies Act, SEBI regulations, FEMA Act, Listing Requirements, etc.

3A. Team Member / Leader – Finance

Criteria Details
Essential Educational Qualification CA (Final Examination cleared in First attempt) with minimum 55% aggregate (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD) OR ICWA (Final Examination cleared in First attempt) with minimum 55% aggregate (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD).
Essential Work Experience (as on 01.04.2026) Minimum 14 years of post-qualification experience in Finance / Accounts / Treasury Operations / Taxation / Auditing / Budgeting / Governance & Compliance etc.

4A. Head Sales (Petrochemical Taskforce)

Criteria Details
Essential Educational Qualification B.E. / B.Tech in Chemical / Mechanical / Polymer / Petrochemical / Plastics Engineering / Plastics Technology with minimum 60% aggregate (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD) OR PhD / M.Sc in Applied Polymer Science / Polymer Science with minimum 60% (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD) OR MBA / PGDM with minimum 60% aggregate (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD).
Essential Work Experience (as on 01.04.2026) Minimum 21 years’ post-qualification work experience in marketing, with at least 10 years in Sales / Marketing / Branding in the petrochemical / polymer industry.

4B. Technical Officer – Polymer Marketing

Criteria Details
Essential Educational Qualification Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering / Polymer Science / Polymer Engineering / Materials Science / Materials Engineering / Petrochemical Engineering / Plastics Engineering / Plastics Technology with minimum 60% aggregate (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD) OR PhD / M.Sc in Applied Polymer Science / Polymer Science with minimum 60% (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD).
Essential Work Experience (as on 01.04.2026) Minimum 4 years of experience in polymer processing / application development / technical service within the polymer industry.

5A. Team Lead – WSA (Highway Rest Stops)

Criteria Details
Essential Educational Qualification Full-time Masters / Post Graduate Diploma in Business Administration / Hospitality Management / Retail Management / Marketing Management / Operations Management / Hotel Management with minimum 60% aggregate (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD).
Essential Work Experience (as on 01.04.2026) Minimum 10 years of relevant post-qualification experience, of which at least 5 years in retail operations and/or hospitality/hotel management and/or business strategy and/or marketing and/or revenue management in Convenience Retail / QSR / F&B Chains / Hospitality / Mall facility / Airport or Railway retail or F&B operations; with at least 2 years in a team leadership role covering multi-store / multi-location / multi-facility managing complete P&L.

5B. Site Manager – WSA (Highway Rest Stops)

Criteria Details
Essential Educational Qualification B.E. / B.Tech with minimum 60% aggregate AND Masters / PG Diploma in Hospitality with minimum 60% aggregate (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD) OR Graduation (other than B.E./B.Tech) with Masters / PG Diploma in Business Administration / Hospitality with minimum 60% aggregate (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD).
Essential Work Experience (as on 01.04.2026) Minimum 5 years of relevant post-qualification experience, of which at least 3 years in Facility Management / QSR / Food & Beverage Chains / Retail Store Operations / Hospitality Management / Hotel Management / Mall facility management.

BPCL Experienced Professionals Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Age limits vary by post and are reckoned as on 01-04-2026. Upper age limit indicated is for General (UR) and EWS candidates. Age relaxations are applicable as per Presidential Directives for reserved categories. The maximum age of the candidate should not exceed 55 years (for posts with absolute cap) or not exceed General age limit + 10 years (cumulative relaxation cap) as applicable to the respective post.

BPCL Experienced Professionals Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

The application fee is applicable for all positions. Fee once paid will NOT be refunded under any circumstances. Chargeback cannot be claimed for any reason. Payment must be completed online; no other mode is accepted.

Category Application Fee
General (UR) / OBC-NCL / EWS / Ex-Servicemen Rs. 1,180/- (Application fee Rs. 1,000/- + GST @ 18% i.e. Rs. 180/-) + payment gateway charges if applicable (Non-Refundable)
SC / ST / PwBD NIL (Exempted)
Payment Mode Online only - Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI / Net Banking

BPCL Experienced Professionals Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The multi-stage selection process will be adopted based on the number of applications received for each profile. Final selection is subject to document verification, performance in all selection stages, and Pre-Employment Medical Examination.

Stage 1 – Application Screening

Applications will be screened on the basis of years of relevant work experience, educational qualification, and other eligibility criteria as specified for each profile.

Stage 2 – Computer Based Test (CBT)

Part Section Details
Part I General Aptitude Verbal Ability, Quantitative Aptitude and Logical Reasoning
Part II Professional Knowledge Questions related to the area of specialization of the applied profile

Stage 3 – Case Based Discussion / Group Task / Personal Interview

Candidates shortlisted in the CBT (category-wise and discipline-wise merit list) will be called for Case Based Discussion and/or Group Task and/or Personal Interview. Document verification shall be conducted before this stage. Provisional selection will be based on relevant work experience, on-the-job achievements, and overall performance across all selection stages.

Stage 4 – Pre-Employment Medical Examination

Provisionally selected candidates must clear a Pre-Employment Medical Examination conducted by BPCL’s authorized doctor / nominated hospital as per OISD-GDN-166 guidelines. Medical fitness decision shall be final and binding. Reference for medical examination does not mean final selection.

BPCL Experienced Professionals Recruitment 2026 - Emoluments / Pay Scale

Selected candidates will be placed in appropriate grades (E2 to E8) and pay points based on profile, qualification, experience, and performance in selection. CTC indicated is at the minimum of the pay scale for metro city postings.

CTC includes Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance (IDA pattern), HRA, Perks & Allowances, Retirement Benefits (DPE guidelines), and Performance-Related Pay. Additional benefits include medical coverage for self and dependants, annual leave entitlements, housing loan, education loan, furniture-on-hire, conveyance allowance, and communication expenses.

How to Apply for BPCL Experienced Professionals Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply online only; no other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates must read the detailed advertisement carefully before applying. All details entered in the online form will be treated as final and no changes will be entertained after submission.

Documents Required to be Scanned and Uploaded (PDF format):

  • Date of Birth Proof (Class 10th / DOB Certificate)
  • Educational Qualification Proof - Consolidated Marksheet AND Degree / Diploma Certificate (both mandatory)
  • Service Certificate / Work-Experience Certificate(s) from each organization on their letterhead, signed/stamped by authorized representative, showing: Name, Designation, Length of Service, Date of Joining, Date of Separation (if applicable), Nature of Employment (Full-time / Part-time), Detailed Nature of Work, and Current Basic Salary and CTC
  • Relevant Category / Caste Certificate (SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen) - issued for appointments under Government of India
  • Recent Color Passport Size Photograph (not older than April 2026)
  • Scanned copy of Signature (signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted)
  • Latest three salary slips from current organization (scanned together in a single PDF file)

Additional Documents to be Produced at the time of Selection Process / Document Verification:

  • Call Letter / Admit Card along with a valid photo identity proof in original and self-attested photocopy
  • Caste Certificate in prescribed Government of India format (for SC/ST candidates)
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate in prescribed Government of India format (for OBC-NCL candidates); self-undertaking to be submitted at time of Personal Interview
  • Income and Asset Certificate issued by Competent Authority valid for FY 2026-27 (for EWS candidates); must be submitted at the time of interview
  • Disability Certificate issued by a Competent Authority as per RPwBD Act, 2016 (for PwBD candidates)
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from employer - mandatory for candidates presently employed in Central/State Government, Autonomous bodies, and PSUs

Apply Online at: www.bharatpetroleum.in → CAREERS → CURRENT JOB OPENING → APPLY ONLINE

For queries: Email - [email protected] (mention Application ID in the subject line). Candidates are NOT required to send printout of application or any other documents in hard copy to BPCL.

BPCL Experienced Professionals Recruitment 2026 - Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All eligibility criteria - age, qualification, and experience - are reckoned as on 01-04-2026.
  • Candidates can apply for only one profile. Candidates are advised to submit only one application; in case of multiple applications, only the latest one shall be considered as final.
  • Percentage of marks is calculated on the basis of total marks obtained in all semesters/years in all subjects. Rounding off of percentage is not allowed.
  • Experience gained only after the date of declaration of result of the qualifying degree will be considered. Short-term trainee experience (summer/winter internships during degree) will not be counted.
  • All qualifications must be from AICTE approved / UGC recognized University / Deemed University. Equivalent percentage for CGPA/OGPA must be indicated and supported by a certificate from the University.
  • OBC candidates belonging to ‘Creamy Layer’ are not entitled for OBC-NCL reservation; they must apply as General. OBC-NCL certificate should clearly indicate non-creamy layer status.
  • Candidates presently employed in Central / State Government, Autonomous bodies, PSUs must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of selection process.
  • All future communications will be through e-mail only. The email ID and mobile number must remain valid for at least one year. BPCL will not be responsible for non-delivery due to invalid email ID.
  • No email confirmation will be sent on successful registration or fee payment. Candidates must take a printout of the payment acknowledgment for future reference.
  • 3rd AC train fare reimbursement is admissible for CBT for outstation SC, ST & PwBD candidates. 2nd AC train fare is admissible for all outstation candidates appearing in the Interview (distance of not less than 30 km). This is not applicable for candidates already in Central / State Government Services / PSUs.
  • Corrigendum / Addendum, if any, will be published on the official BPCL website only - https://www.bharatpetroleum.in/ - candidates must check regularly.
  • BPCL reserves the right to cancel / restrict / enlarge / modify / alter the recruitment process at any stage without notice.
  • Canvassing in any form at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Mumbai.
  • All applications are accepted through the online portal only. This activity has NOT been outsourced by BPCL to any agency/individual. Applicants are advised to beware of fraudulent agencies/individuals.

CEIL Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

The notification does not mention any application fee. Applications are to be submitted online free of charge through CEIL's official recruitment portal at https://www6.eil.co.in/ceilrecruitment/.

CEIL Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Applications received will be put up to a Committee for shortlisting. Screening and selection will be based on the details provided in the application form - only accurate, full and correct information should be furnished. Furnishing of wrong/false information will result in disqualification.

For Officer Grade Posts (QA/QC, Safety, Marketing, SCM, Office Management): Shortlisting based on application details, followed by Personal Interview. Interviews will be held at CEIL office, Navi Mumbai. Online interviews (Skype, Google Meet, or similar) may also be conducted if required.

For HR Associate Category: Selection will be done through Written Test. Candidates complying with the criteria will be shortlisted for the written test.

CEIL may restrict the number of candidates called for interview / written test based on academic excellence, age, and experience. Selected candidates will be on panel and appointment letters will be issued as per requirement.

Who should NOT apply for CEIL Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not hold an Engineering Degree or Diploma in the relevant discipline with minimum 50% marks - this is a hard requirement for all technical posts.
  • Mechanical/Production QA/QC candidates who do not have ASNT Level-II certification in NDT methods (UT, RT, MPT, PT) - this is mandatory and non-negotiable.
  • Candidates who do not have the prescribed minimum post-qualification experience as on 30.04.2026 - experience counted is post-PQ only.
  • Candidates exceeding the maximum age limit for their respective grade and discipline (Degree or Diploma holder category) as on 30.04.2026.
  • Candidates looking for a permanent government job - this is a Fixed Term Contract with no liability on CEIL for regular appointment at any stage; total contract period will not exceed 36 months under any circumstances.
  • Candidates not willing to serve anywhere in India - posting can be at any CEIL office or project site across India at the discretion of management.
  • OBC candidates from creamy layer - only OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates are eligible for reservation benefits.
  • PwD candidates with less than 40% disability - minimum 40% disability is required for PwD relaxation benefits.
  • Candidates without a valid and functional email ID that can remain active for at least 24 months from date of application - all communications will be via email only.
  • Candidates for the Safety Officer post without a Degree/Diploma in Industrial Safety in addition to the engineering degree - both are mandatory.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying for CEIL Recruitment 2026?

  • Not checking ASNT Level-II certification status before applying for Mechanical/Production QA/QC posts - it is mandatory and absence will disqualify the application.
  • Miscalculating experience years - experience must be post-qualification (after engineering degree/diploma) and is counted as on 30.04.2026, not the date of application.
  • Applying with CGPA/OGPA without converting to equivalent percentage - candidates must indicate the equivalent percentage as per university/institute norms and be ready to produce documentary proof at interview.
  • Applying through any mode other than CEIL's official recruitment portal (https://www6.eil.co.in/ceilrecruitment/) - applications through any other mode will not be entertained.
  • Providing an incorrect or inactive email ID - all communications including interview/test intimation will be via email only; CEIL will not be responsible for loss of communication due to invalid email.
  • Applying for Grade-II posts in Marketing, SCM, or Office Management without adequate experience in those specific functional areas - engineering qualification alone is not sufficient; relevant functional experience is mandatory.
  • Not keeping track of CEIL's official website www.ceil.co.in - any change in last date or other schedule will be communicated only through the website, not separately.
  • Attending the interview without carrying all original documents - absence of any required document (age proof, marksheets, experience certificates, salary slip, category certificate) will result in disqualification from interview.
  • Canvassing in any form - this will immediately result in disqualification.
  • Not preparing 5 copies of the Annexure (CV format) - shortlisted candidates will need to bring 5 copies of the Annexure, which will be sent only to shortlisted candidates by CEIL.

How to Apply for CEIL Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply online only through CEIL's official recruitment portal. Applications received through any other mode shall not be entertained. Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date. Applications found incomplete or received after the due date are liable to be rejected.

Documents Required at the time of Interview:

  • Proof of Age (10th / Matriculation certificate)
  • Educational and Professional Qualifications (all marksheets & certificates)
  • Service Certificate of past employment, proof of date of joining & continuity in present organization (if applicable) & latest salary slip
  • Medical Certificate for PwD (if applicable) with photograph from competent authority, confirming minimum 40% disability
  • SC / ST / OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate from competent authority (OBC certificate must clearly state non-creamy layer status)
  • EWS certificate from competent authority
  • 5 copies of duly filled Annexure / CV (format sent to shortlisted candidates only)

Apply Online at: https://www6.eil.co.in/ceilrecruitment/

For further updates: Visit www.ceil.co.in → Careers section

Important Instructions for CEIL Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • This is a Fixed Term Contract engagement - purely on a temporary basis. It does not carry any liability on CEIL for regular appointment at any stage. Total contract period will not exceed 36 months under any circumstances.
  • Initial appointment is for one year, extendable (if required) for another 36 months or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier, subject to satisfactory performance.
  • Selected candidates will initially be posted at CEIL Head Office, Navi Mumbai but may be posted at any CEIL office or project site anywhere in India at management's discretion. Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India need apply.
  • No perks or allowances other than the consolidated salary are payable. In case of extension beyond one year, increment @ 3% per year will be considered for the next 2 years.
  • Fixed Term Personnel must take Medical Insurance of minimum ₹2,00,000/- for self; the premium will be reimbursed by CEIL.
  • CGPA/OGPA/CPI or letter grade in Degree must be converted to equivalent percentage as per university/institute norms and documentary proof will be required at interview.
  • No TA/DA will be given for attending interviews.
  • Candidates must be of sound health; Medical Fitness Certificate from Government Hospital / Company Nominated Hospital is required at the time of joining (expense reimbursable on original receipt).
  • Contractual engagement may be terminated by CEIL at any time at its sole discretion without assigning any reason if performance/conduct is found unsatisfactory.
  • For termination during currency of contract, one month's written notice or one month's consolidated pay in lieu thereof shall be given by either party.
  • Reservation and relaxation for PwDs shall be as per GOI guidelines. Persons with 40% or more disabilities are eligible.
  • Experience prescribed is relaxable at the discretion of CEIL for SC/ST candidates.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • Number of vacancies indicated are only tentative; CEIL reserves the right to cancel/restrict/modify/alter selection/recruitment process at any stage without notice.
  • CEIL also reserves the right to reject any candidature without assigning any reason whatsoever.
  • Any dispute arising from this recruitment will be under the jurisdiction of Mumbai court only.

EdCIL Multidisciplinary Staff 2026 – Educational Qualifications

Candidates must possess the prescribed qualifications from Government/RCI recognized institutions and fulfil the eligibility criteria as on 30 April 2026.

Occupational Therapist (125 Posts)

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Occupational Therapy from a recognized institution.
  • Valid registration/license to practise as an Occupational Therapist in India, as per applicable state regulations.
  • Strong clinical reasoning and problem-solving abilities, excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team, with a compassionate, patient-centred approach.
  • Experienced candidates in the relevant field will be given added advantage.

Physiotherapist (125 Posts)

  • Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree in Physiotherapy from a recognized institution.
  • Valid professional registration/license.
  • Strong clinical reasoning and communication skills, compassionate approach, ability to work independently and in a team.
  • Experienced candidates in the relevant field will be given added advantage.

Psychologist (125 Posts)

  • M.A./M.Sc in Psychology from a recognized university (Clinical/Counselling/Developmental Psychology preferred).
  • Experience in psychological assessments and behavioural therapies.
  • Strong communication, counselling and interpersonal skills, ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Experienced candidates in the relevant field will be given added advantage.

Speech Therapist (125 Posts)

  • Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree in Speech-Language Pathology or Audiology & Speech-Language Pathology from a recognized institution.
  • Mandatory valid registration with the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI).
  • Experience working with children with Autism and developmental disorders preferred.
  • Strong assessment, communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in Telugu and English (knowledge of other local languages is an added advantage).
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team; experienced candidates will be given added advantage.

Clinical Psychologist (125 Posts)

  • Post Graduation in Clinical Psychology from an institution recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI).
  • Mandatory valid RCI registration.
  • Strong expertise in psychological assessments and behavioural therapies.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; proficiency in Telugu is an added advantage.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team; experienced candidates will be given added advantage.

  • The candidate must possess any one of the following RCI-recognised qualifications with valid CRR number:
    • Bachelor’s Degree + B.Ed. (Special Education), OR
    • Bachelor’s Degree + B.Ed. (General) with 1-year Diploma in Autism/Intellectual Disability, OR
    • Bachelor’s Degree + B.Ed. (General) with D.Ed. in Autism/Intellectual Disability.
  • Qualified AP TET (Paper-2B mandatory) / CTET in Special Education.
  • Experienced candidates in the relevant field will be given added advantage.

  • Must have passed Intermediate (10+2) from a recognized Board.
  • Must possess a two-year Diploma in Special Education (Autism/Intellectual Disability) recognized by RCI with valid CRR number.
  • Qualified AP TET (Paper-1B mandatory) / CTET in Special Education.
  • Experienced candidates in the relevant field will be given added advantage.

  • Ph.D./M.Phil in Clinical Psychology/Psychology/Special Education.
  • Desirable: Ph.D in the field of rehabilitation of Persons with Disabilities.
  • Experienced candidates in the relevant field will be given added advantage.
  • Expertise in report writing and strong communication skills is mandatory.

  • The last date for receipt of online applications is 04 June 2026.
  • No application fee is required for any of the posts.

NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Selection Process

Selection will be made purely on the basis of merit drawn from qualifying examination marks, followed by document scrutiny and a mandatory medical test. No written examination will be conducted by NCL for this recruitment.

Stage 1 – Merit List Preparation

For Graduate and Diploma positions, merit is drawn on the basis of marks scored in the qualifying Graduation/Diploma examination. For ITI Trade positions, merit is based on the average of passing percentage in Matriculation and the respective National/State Trade Certificate. Candidates are arranged in descending order of marks. In case of a tie, date of birth (older candidate preferred) and then alphabetical order of name will be applied.

Stage 2 – Document Scrutiny

Shortlisted candidates based on merit will be called to appear with all original certificates for scrutiny. Date and venue will be notified on nclcil.in and through NATS/NAPS portal or email. Failure to appear or produce valid documents within the stipulated date and time will result in cancellation of candidature.

Stage 3 – Medical Examination

Final offer for Apprenticeship Training is subject to clearing the Medical Test as per prescribed standards under the Mines Rules 1955. A fitness certificate from the medical officer of a Government Hospital (rank not less than Assistant Civil Surgeon) in the prescribed format (Annexure-3) must be produced. The Medical Fitness certificate must be issued after the date of release of this Notification.

Who should NOT apply for NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27?

  • Candidates who have already undergone Apprenticeship Training earlier or are currently pursuing Apprenticeship in any industry.
  • Candidates with 1 year or more of job experience.
  • Candidates who have passed their qualifying degree/diploma/ITI before June 2022.
  • Candidates who possess qualifications higher than the prescribed qualification for the applied discipline.
  • Candidates whose qualifying institution is not functional and operational in Uttar Pradesh or Madhya Pradesh.
  • Candidates whose qualifications were obtained through Part-time, Correspondence, or Distance Learning mode.
  • OBC candidates belonging to the Creamy Layer.
  • Candidates who submit multiple applications - multiple applications will lead to disqualification.
  • Candidates who are unable to produce a valid Medical Fitness certificate as per Mines Rules 1955.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27?

  • Not pre-registering on the NATS portal (for Graduate/Diploma) or NAPS portal (for Trade/ITI) before applying - without a valid Enrolment ID, the application cannot be completed.
  • Applying for more than one discipline - multiple applications will lead to disqualification of candidature.
  • Entering incorrect percentage/marks scored or maximum marks in the online form - candidature will be cancelled if found incorrect during scrutiny.
  • Not checking that the qualifying institution is functional and operational in Uttar Pradesh or Madhya Pradesh.
  • Uploading blurred or unclear photograph or signature in black ink.
  • Not having an active email ID and mobile number valid for at least one year for future communication.
  • Rounding off the passing percentage - NCL will not consider rounding off (49.99% will be treated as less than 50%).
  • Not taking a printout of the finally submitted online application for future reference.

How to Apply for NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27

Candidates must apply online only. Graduate and Diploma Apprentice candidates must first enrol on the NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and Trade Apprentice candidates must enrol on the NAPS portal at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. After successful registration, a registration number (Enrolment ID) will be generated, following which the candidate must apply for the NCL positions through the respective portal.

Documents/Details required at the time of Online Application:

  • Valid NATS/NAPS Enrolment ID (registration reference).
  • Scanned colour photograph and scanned signature in black ink (as per portal specifications).

  • PwBD disability certificate as per Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules 2017 (Annexure-2), if applicable.
  • Address for correspondence and permanent address.

Candidates must save and preserve a hard copy as well as soft copy of the finally submitted online application for future reference. No paper-based or postal applications will be accepted.

Oil India Limited Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection for all notified posts is through Personal Interview (PI) only - there is no written examination. Shortlisting will be done based on details furnished in the online application. Only eligible/shortlisted candidates will be notified for PI via email. If the number of applications is very large, OIL may raise the minimum eligible standards to restrict the number of candidates called for PI. Provisionally selected candidates must clear Pre-Employment Medical Examination (PEME) at OIL Hospital, Duliajan, Assam or at a Government Medical Officer (Civil Surgeon rank or above) or OIL-empanelled hospital before final appointment.

Oil India Limited Recruitment 2026 - Post-wise Job Description Summary

Each post carries a defined technical/functional scope. The table below gives a quick summary to help candidates assess alignment with their background before applying.

Post Core Functional Areas Key Tools / Domain Knowledge Required
Deputy Chief Chemist Drilling/workover fluid preparation, testing and quality control; wellsite chemical management; inventory, documentation and chemical operations at drilling/workover sites; cementing, oil spotting, loss control and well kick management support Drilling fluid rheology; HSE compliance; chemical operations management
Deputy Chief Geologist Geological studies and interpretation; basin analysis; wellsite geology; mud logging; core and cuttings analysis; formation evaluation; well log interpretation; subsurface evaluation and field development planning; technical report and map preparation Petrel, Kingdom Suite or equivalent geological software; sedimentology; structural geology; geo-statistics
Deputy Chief Engineer (Reservoir) Reservoir characterization and modelling; hydrocarbon reserves estimation (SPE/PRMS); dynamic reservoir simulation; field development planning; well and reservoir performance monitoring; enhanced oil recovery studies ECLIPSE, CMG or equivalent simulation software; decline curve analysis; material balance methods
Deputy Chief Geophysicist 2D/3D seismic data acquisition and processing; seismic interpretation (AVO, inversion, attributes); gravity/magnetic/EM surveys; integration of geophysical, geological and GIS data; prospect generation and basin modelling Modern geophysical software; machine learning for interpretation; VSP; quantitative interpretation techniques
Deputy Chief Engineer (S&E) Safety Management Systems (SMS); HSE inspections, audits, risk assessments; incident/accident investigation; statutory compliance (Factories Act, DGMS, OISD, PNGRB, PESO, CPCB/SPCB); EIA/EMP; environmental auditing; ESG/CSR/BRSR/GRI/SBTi/SDG framework integration ISO 14001; GIS/environmental modelling tools; HSE data analysis; emergency response planning

Who should NOT apply for Oil India Limited Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates whose post-qualification work experience does not meet the minimum 09 years (or 13/17 years for Economist Grade E/F) as on 28-06-2026 - even one day short disqualifies.
  • Candidates whose experience has been acquired through academic, research, fellowship, JRF/SRF, PhD scholar, project-based, consultancy, internship, apprenticeship or part-time/ad-hoc roles - all such experience is explicitly excluded from "Post Qualification Relevant Work Experience" under this notification.
  • Candidates applying for Deputy Chief Geophysicist (GEOP-04) with a PG in Computational Seismology or similar excluded streams - the notification specifically disqualifies such qualifications.
  • Private sector candidates from companies with an annual turnover of less than Rs. 500 Crores - they are not eligible under OIL's experience recognition policy.
  • Candidates in regular Government/PSU employment who do not have minimum 2 years of service in the next lower pay scale equivalent as prescribed in Table-III of the notification - they will be screened out at document verification.
  • Candidates whose educational qualification nomenclature does not exactly match what is prescribed - OIL has explicitly stated that no variation in qualification nomenclature will be accepted.
  • Candidates who cannot produce NOC from their current Government/PSU employer at the time of Personal Interview - without NOC they will not be allowed to appear for the interview and travel fares will not be reimbursed.
  • Candidates unable to pass Pre-Employment Medical Examination (PEME) as per OIL's physical fitness standards - final appointment will be cancelled if declared medically unfit.
  • Candidates whose percentage is arrived at by rounding off - OIL explicitly states rounding off of percentage is not allowed for eligibility determination.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying Oil India Limited Recruitment 2026?

  • Not uploading a separate document detailing roles and responsibilities for each employment claimed - beyond the experience certificate, OIL mandates a separate role/responsibility document from each employer; missing this leads to rejection of experience claim.
  • Uploading only an offer letter for past employment without also submitting two mandatory supporting documents from the prescribed list (last pay slip, increment letter, promotion order, PF statement, or appointment letter) - non-submission of both supporting documents can lead to rejection of candidature.
  • Claiming CGPA as percentage without converting to percentage as per university/institute norms - CGPA must be converted and the equivalent percentage clearly mentioned; rounding off is not permitted.
  • Using the same email ID or mobile number as another candidate - the same email/mobile cannot be shared between candidates; duplicate details will cause registration failure.
  • Submitting multiple applications and not ensuring the one with the highest Application Sequence Number is complete - OIL will only process the application with the highest sequence number for each post.
  • Uploading documents exceeding 5 MB per file or 200 MB total - applications with oversized attachments may face technical rejection.
  • Not applying for each post separately - candidates eligible for multiple posts must register and submit separate applications for each post.
  • Candidates applying for Economist post not specifying the Grade (D/E/F) they are applying for clearly - eligibility and experience requirements differ for each grade and applications are scrutinized accordingly.
  • OBC candidates submitting an outdated Non-Creamy Layer certificate - the NCL certificate must clearly state that the candidate does not belong to the creamy layer as defined by Government of India for Central Government services; an old or vague certificate will not be accepted.
  • Being misled by fraudulent job offers - OIL has specifically warned that unscrupulous individuals are issuing fake appointment letters; all genuine communications come only from the official OIL website and registered email ID.

How to Apply for Oil India Limited Recruitment 2026

Candidates must apply online only through the OIL website. No other mode of application will be accepted. Printouts of online applications should NOT be sent to OIL by post or hand.

Step I – Sign Up / Registration: Visit https://www.oil-india.com/advertisement-list and click on "Advertisement for Recruitment of Officers in Grade D/E/F in OIL." Select the post, fill in personal details, valid email ID and mobile number. Complete OTP authentication. Note down the Application Number and password received on registered email/mobile.

Step II – Complete Application Form: Fill in Basic Details, Address, Qualification Details, Eligibility Details, Experience Details. Upload photo, signature and scanned certificates. Click "Submit" to finalize.

Documents to be Uploaded Online:

  • Recent passport size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg/PNG format, not older than 3 weeks)
  • Signature on white paper with black ink pen (jpg/jpeg/PNG format)
  • Birth Certificate or Matriculation/10th Admit Card/Pass Certificate/Marksheet showing date of birth - no other document accepted for age proof
  • Degree/Diploma certificates and mark sheets for all academic years (or provisional certificate if degree not yet issued)
  • Experience Letter/Service Certificate from each employer on official letterhead (with name, designation, dates of joining and relieving)
  • Separate document from each employer explicitly detailing roles and responsibilities performed
  • Any two supporting documents per employment from the prescribed list: last pay slip, annual increment letter, promotion/transfer order, PF statement, or offer/appointment letter (for past employment); or identity card, increment letter, promotion/transfer order, PF statement (for current employment)
  • Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL) in Government of India prescribed format, if applicable
  • Valid NCL certificate for OBC candidates, if applicable
  • Valid EWS Income & Assets Certificate in Government of India format, if applicable
  • Valid Disability Certificate (min. 40% disability) for PwBD candidates, if applicable
  • Valid Discharge Book/Service and Release Certificate for Ex-Servicemen, if applicable
  • Domicile Certificate (J&K, 1980–1989) for age relaxation claim, if applicable
  • CGPA/Grade to percentage conversion certificate from university/institute, if marks are in CGPA/Grade format
  • NOC from current employer (for Government/PSU employees - mandatory at PI stage)

Apply Online at: https://www.oil-india.com/advertisement-list

Important Instructions for Oil India Limited Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.
  • The Cut-off date for all matters - age, experience, qualification - is 28-06-2026.
  • Mere possession of minimum qualifications does not entitle candidates to be called for PI; shortlisting criteria may be raised if the number of applications is large.
  • Candidates in permanent Government/PSU employment must produce a valid NOC from their employer at the time of PI - without this they will not be permitted to appear and travel fares will not be reimbursed.
  • Appointment of provisionally selected candidates is subject to medical fitness as per OIL's Physical Fitness criteria; candidature is cancelled if declared unfit by OIL's Medical Board.
  • Provisionally selected candidates will serve a probationary period of 1 year and will be confirmed in writing after successful completion.
  • Any false information or document at any stage - even after joining - will result in cancellation/termination and blacklisting from all future OIL recruitments.
  • All future announcements for this vacancy will be published only on www.oil-india.com - not on any other website or medium.
  • OIL has warned all candidates about fraudulent fake appointment letters being circulated by unscrupulous elements - OIL does not authorize any person/organization outside OIL to offer jobs on its behalf.
  • Any dispute regarding recruitment under this advertisement will be under the jurisdiction of Dibrugarh District Court only.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • OIL strives to have a gender-balanced workforce and women candidates are encouraged to apply.

Punjab & Sind Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection for engagement of apprentices will be merit-based on HSC/10+2 marks. No written examination is conducted. Final selection is subject to verification of eligibility, district-wise vacancy availability, and medical fitness. In case of a tie in marks, candidates will be ranked by age in descending order within their respective category, state, and district.

Stage 1 - Merit List (Based on HSC / 10+2 Marks)

Candidates who fulfill minimum eligibility criteria will be placed in a merit list in descending order of their 10+2 marks, drawn State-wise, District-wise, and Category-wise. No written examination is conducted for this recruitment. Candidates must select their preferred State and District in the application itself. In case of equal marks, tie-break is by age in descending order within the respective category, state, and district.

Stage 2 - Document Verification

Shortlisted candidates will be intimated through email only and must appear for document verification at their own expense. Original documents along with self-attested photocopies must be produced. Candidates failing to produce originals will not be allowed to proceed further.

Stage 3 - Medical Examination

Engagement of selected apprentices is subject to being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Bank.

Competition Level Analysis for Punjab & Sind Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The competition level for PSB Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is expected to be moderate to high. With only 635 seats spread across 29 States/UTs, the vacancy count is significantly lower than comparable bank apprenticeship drives such as SBI. Selection is purely merit-based on 10+2 marks without any written examination, which means candidates with high HSC scores - especially from states like Uttar Pradesh (100 seats), Punjab (90 seats), Bihar (40 seats), Maharashtra (30 seats), and Haryana (50 seats) - will face intense competition within their district and category.

Since there is no written exam, the effective competition depends entirely on the candidate's 10+2 percentage and age as a tie-breaker. Attrition at later stages will occur through local language proof verification, document verification, and medical fitness, which will reduce the final eligible pool. Candidates who do not have proof of studying the local language at 8th/10th/12th level are at a disadvantage as they must demonstrate local language proficiency separately.

Who should NOT apply for Punjab & Sind Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates looking for a permanent job; this is a 12-month apprenticeship only, with no guarantee of absorption or regular employment in the Bank.
  • Candidates who have already completed any Apprenticeship (in PSB or any other organisation) or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act.
  • Candidates who have completed Post Graduate (PG) qualification - PG holders are explicitly not eligible.
  • Candidates with 1 year or more of work/job experience after completion of educational qualification.
  • Candidates who have completed more than 5 years after passing their qualifying examination.
  • Candidates outside the age band of 20–28 years as on 01-05-2026, except those eligible for notified relaxation under SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/widow/1984 riot victim categories.
  • Aspirants who do not hold a Regular Graduation degree from a recognized University/Institute by 06-06-2026.
  • Candidates not proficient in the local language of the State/UT they are applying for, and who cannot produce 8th/10th/12th or graduation-level certificate evidencing study of that language.
  • Candidates unwilling or unable to register with 100% completed profile on both NAPS (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) and NATS (nats.education.gov.in) portals before applying - this is a mandatory prerequisite.
  • Candidates without a valid Aadhaar number, as it is mandatory before engagement/contract signing.
  • Candidates applying with a Ration Card or Learner's Driving License as ID proof - these are not accepted as valid identity documents for this process.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying Punjab & Sind Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

  • Not completing 100% profile on both NAPS and NATS portals before applying; incomplete portal profiles will render the candidate ineligible.
  • Applying for a wrong State or District where the candidate is not proficient in the local language and cannot produce language study certificates.
  • Entering the wrong category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/UR); category cannot be changed after submission and any mismatch at document verification can lead to cancellation.
  • OBC candidates from the creamy layer applying under OBC reservation instead of UR; only Non-Creamy Layer OBC candidates with a valid, recent certificate are entitled to reservation.
  • Uploading blurred or incorrect photograph, signature, thumb impression or handwritten declaration (wrong size, format, or written by someone else) leading to rejection at scrutiny.
  • Using an invalid or inactive mobile number or email ID, resulting in failure to receive OTPs, shortlisting intimations, or further communication from the Bank.
  • Submitting multiple applications; only the last valid completed application will be retained and fees paid for other registrations will be forfeited.
  • Signing the application in CAPITAL LETTERS; signatures in capital letters are not acceptable and must match across all documents and correspondence.
  • Forgetting to note down the Enrollment ID generated on the NATS portal, which is mandatory to be mentioned while applying for training seats.
  • Not reading the clause that this is not regular employment, and later disputing about permanent absorption after the 12-month apprenticeship ends.

How to Apply for Punjab & Sind Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply online through the Bank's website (https://punjabandsind.bank.in/) only. No other mode of application will be accepted. Before applying, candidates must mandatorily complete 100% registration on both the NAPS portal (https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/) and the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in/). Candidates must also note down their Enrollment ID generated on the NATS portal as it is required while applying.

  • Signature with black ink on white paper (Signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted)
  • Left Thumb Impression on white paper with black or blue ink
  • Handwritten Declaration in English on white paper with black ink - text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Live photograph captured via webcam or mobile phone (to be uploaded at time of online application)
  • Image files must be in .jpg / .jpeg format; scanned documents must be in PDF format only

Documents to be Produced at the time of Document Verification / Joining:

  • Xth / Date of Birth certificate in support of Date of Birth
  • Printout of application form
  • All certificates and mark sheets of educational qualification from Standard Xth, XII, and Graduation onwards
  • Caste Certificate in prescribed Government of India format for SC/ST candidates
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate in prescribed format, valid as on date of joining (issued within one year prior to joining); OBC Caste Name must tally with Central Government list
  • Income and Asset Certificate in prescribed format issued by competent authority, valid EWS certificate for the financial year, for EWS category candidates
  • Disability Certificate in prescribed format issued by District Medical Board for PwBD candidates
  • Age relaxation proof with valid documents (e.g., District Magistrate certificate for 1984 riot-affected persons)
  • Photo Identity Proof (PAN Card / Passport / Permanent Driving License / Voter’s Card / Bank Passbook with photograph / Aadhaar / E-Aadhaar / Identity Card issued by recognised College/University / Gazetted Officer certificate) - bearing the same name as on the application / call letter. Ration Card and Learner’s Driving License are NOT valid.
  • Two passport-size photographs similar to the one used during portal registration
  • Any other relevant documents in support of eligibility

NO DOCUMENT SHOULD BE DIRECTLY SENT TO THE BANK BEFORE OR AFTER THE PROCESS. Printout of Application Form is NOT to be sent to the Bank. Candidates must appear for document verification at their own expense.

Apply Online at: https://punjabandsind.bank.in/ → Home Page → Recruitment → Relevant Notification

Important Instructions for Punjab & Sind Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • THIS IS NOT AN EMPLOYMENT IN THE BANK. Candidates engaged as Apprentice will NOT be treated as "employees" of the Bank and will not be entitled to receive any benefits available for Bank employees.
  • The Bank shall have no obligation to offer regular employment to any Apprentice who has completed the period of training, nor shall the Apprentice be obligated to accept employment. The Apprentice shall have no right to claim employment in the Bank after completion of training.
  • Candidates can apply for only one State and one District, and not more than one application should be submitted. In case of multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained and fees for other registrations will stand forfeited.
  • Mandatory registration with 100% completed profile on both NAPS and NATS portals before applying on the Bank's website is required.
  • Candidates who had training or job experience of one or more years after completion of educational qualifications shall not be eligible for engagement as apprentice.
  • OBC candidates belonging to the "Creamy Layer" are not entitled to reservation/relaxation; they should apply as General/UR.
  • Change of address / email ID / phone number / caste / category will not be entertained after submission of the application.
  • Signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be acceptable. The signature must be consistent across all documents and correspondence.
  • No daily allowance, conveyance allowance or travelling allowance will be paid to Apprentices. No overtime is permitted. Apprentices are entitled to only 1 casual leave per month (maximum 4 at a time).
  • The Contract of Apprenticeship shall terminate automatically on expiry of the 12-month training period. A non-performing apprentice will be given 7 days' notice. An apprentice wishing to terminate early must give 15 days' prior notice to the Bank.
  • Apprentices must devote their entire time exclusively to the Bank and shall not engage in any other commercial business, service, or advisory activity during the engagement period.
  • Apprentices must not disclose any financial information, data, concepts or internal communications relating to the Bank's business to any unauthorized person.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • Any resultant dispute arising out of this advertisement shall be subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts situated at Delhi.
  • Bank reserves the right to change/add/cancel the selection process or cancel the entire process at any stage without notice or refund of application fees.
  • All revisions/corrigendum (if any) will be hosted on the Bank's website only - candidates should visit regularly.

Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026 - How to Apply

  • After clicking the registration box, a confirmation check box will appear for candidates who have previously applied and paid the fee. Those candidates must re-submit the application with the same registration number clearly mentioned, upload documents, and re-submit.

  • Candidates who previously applied and downloaded the application under the earlier notification must register again with a new registration number and re-upload documents per the new requirements. Step 3: Use your registration number and date of birth as login credentials. Review and edit all details and qualification information if needed. Preview the application carefully before confirming. Once submitted, no information can be changed.

  • After uploading photo and signature, upload all required SSLC marks/reservation-related documents with self-attestation, then submit.

Step 5: After submitting, pay the application fee and applicable gateway charges through the Payment Gateway link.

Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026 - Required Documents

The following documents must be uploaded online at the time of application and must be valid as on the last date of application. Originals must be produced at the time of verification.

For All Posts:

  1. Educational qualification certificates or mark sheets for the prescribed qualification (all years/semesters).
  2. SSLC marks card / School attendance certificate or Cumulative Record Extract (for date of birth proof).
  3. Category/reservation certificate as applicable.

For Reservation / Age Relaxation Certificates:

  1. Ex-Servicemen: Discharge certificate and Pension/Gratuity certificate from the authorized authority.
  2. SC/ST (Category A, B, C) / ST-Pangada candidates: Category certificates in the prescribed Government format - SC/ST in Form-D/E/F as applicable; Category-1 candidates in Form-E; 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B candidates in Form-F issued by concerned Tahsildar.
  3. Candidates currently employed: Service certificate from employer and No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the relevant recruitment authority.
  4. Kalyana Karnataka Region candidates: Eligibility proof certificate as per Annexure-2 from the authorized sub-divisional authority.
  5. Rural candidates: Certificate in Form-1 and General candidates in Form-1 and Form-2 from the concerned Tahsildar.
  6. Differently-Abled candidates: Medical certificate from the District-level Medical Board in the prescribed Government format.
  7. Manager / First Division Assistant post: All year/semester mark sheets of the degree.
  8. Second Division Assistant post: Second PUC mark sheets / current student proof.
  9. Vehicle Driver post: SSLC marks card and valid legal driving license.
  10. Junior Servant post: SSLC marks card.
  11. Candidates applying for any post must mandatorily upload a self-portrait passport-size photograph with signature as described above.
  12. Candidates currently working anywhere must upload service certificate from the head of that organization and a No Objection Certificate.
  13. Rural / Ex-Servicemen / Kannada Medium / Differently-Abled category claimants must upload the competent authority-issued certificate.

Special Instructions for Previously Applied Candidates

  • Candidates who had applied and paid the fee under Bank Recruitment Notification No. 12:2026–27 dated 06.04.2026 and who wish to apply for the same posts in the current notification must mandatorily re-apply online. They must clearly mention the previous registration number and re-upload all required documents. No separate fee payment is required for those posts.

  • Candidates who had applied and downloaded the application under the 06.04.2026 notification must register freshly with a new registration number, re-submit, and upload documents as per current requirements. Once Application Re-submit is done, it cannot be re-edited and fees paid will not be refunded. Each post still requires a separate application; one Application Re-submit per post is allowed.
  • Information regarding re-application will be communicated via SMS and email to the registered mobile number and email ID of candidates who had previously applied and downloaded their application under the earlier notification.

Caste Reservation Certificate Requirements

For candidates claiming reservation benefits:

  • SC (Category A, B, C) / ST / Pangada candidates: Upload certificate in Form-D
  • Category-1 candidates: Upload certificate in Form-E
  • Category-2A, 2B, 3A, 3B candidates: Upload certificate in Form-F, obtained from the concerned Tahsildar; these certificates for Backward Hindu categories must be valid within 5 years from the date of application.

Rural Candidate Reservation:

  • Rural candidates must have studied from Class 1 to Class 10 in a village (rural area) under the current rules; certificate must be current and valid.
  • SC/ST/Pangada candidates claiming Rural reservation must submit Form-2 rural reservation certificate.
  • General category candidates claiming rural reservation must submit Form-1 rural certificate along with proof that they are not otherwise listed as urban.
  • General category, SC/ST/Pangada, Category-1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B candidates who fail to submit the required rural reservation certificate will be treated as ineligible for rural reservation.
  • Note: Certificate in Form-2 must be obtained from the Headmaster of the school where the candidate studied and attested by the concerned field education officer.

Kannada Medium Candidates:

  • Candidates claiming Kannada Medium reservation must submit a certificate from the Headmaster of the school where they studied Kannada medium along with date of school's issue, signed certificate, and must be held valid as on the last date of application. Original copies must be produced at verification. If not produced, the Kannada Medium reservation will be cancelled.

Scheme-Deprived (Yojane Nirashritha) Candidates:

  • Must produce a certificate from the concerned Tahsildar in the prescribed format as per current rules. Certificate must be valid up to the last date of application and must be current.

Ex-Servicemen:

  • Ex-Serviceman means a person who has served in any rank (combatant or non-combatant) in the Central Armed Forces (Army, Navy, Air Force) - excluding persons who served in Defence Security Corps, General Reserve Engineering Force, Lok Sahayak Sena, and Para-Military Forces.
  • Family members (spouse/husband/wife and children, including adopted children) of persons who died while serving in Central Armed Forces are eligible for Ex-Servicemen reservation; however, age relaxation will not be provided to them.
  • Eligible cases for Ex-Servicemen reservation:
    • Retired voluntarily from such service after receiving pension; OR
    • Released from military service on medical grounds with medical and physical disability pension; OR
    • Released from service due to reduction of personnel; OR
    • Released from service after completing specific service and receiving gratuity, after fulfilling period of service - including: persons retired from continuous service, persons with physical disability due to military service, and gazette prize winners.
  • Persons currently re-employed in government service after retiring from military service must apply for military reservation through their current service NOC before appointment; they are allowed to enjoy all benefits available to ex-servicemen during re-employment, but the bank will not be responsible if they are not matched with the post. They must submit their discharge certificate before applying.
  • Ex-servicemen applicants, persons dependent on ex-servicemen who were killed or permanently disabled while in service - (spouse/husband/wife and children, including adopted children) - are eligible for Ex-Servicemen reservation benefits. Age relaxation will not be provided to dependents. They must submit the discharge certificate and permanence/gratuity certificate; at the time of original document verification, original copies must be produced.

Differently-Abled (Physically Challenged) Candidates:

  • Only candidates with a minimum of 40% benchmark disability certified by the District-level Medical Board in the prescribed Government format (NOT in any other format) are eligible for differently-abled reservation. Certificate must be issued in the prescribed Government notification format.
  • Differently-Abled candidates who require a scribe for the written examination must upload a special medical certificate from the Medical Board stating that they are unable to write due to physical disability.
  • The scribe requirement must be indicated at the time of application in the specified field in the online application; only when required, the candidate may request a scribe from the examination centre authority.

Who Should NOT Apply for Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not meet the prescribed educational qualifications (degree for Manager/FDA; Second PUC for SDA; SSLC for Driver and Junior Servant) as on the last date of application.

  • Candidates who cannot read, write, speak, and understand Kannada - knowledge of Kannada is mandatory for all posts.
  • Candidates below 18 years of age or above the maximum age limit applicable to their category.
  • OBC (Category-2A/2B/3A/3B) Creamy Layer candidates applying under reserved categories - only non-Creamy Layer OBC candidates are eligible for reservation.
  • Candidates with less than 40% disability who apply for Differently-Abled reservation - only 40%+ benchmark disability qualifies.
  • Vehicle Driver candidates who do not hold a valid legal driving license.
  • Candidates currently employed in any organization who cannot produce an NOC from their employer.
  • Candidates who obtained degrees or certificates from institutions declared fake or derecognized by competent educational authorities - such applications will be rejected at any stage.
  • Candidates who provide false information or suppress facts - such candidates are liable for criminal prosecution and disqualification at any stage of the selection process.
  • Persons who are members of or active in any banned organization, or who have attempted to overthrow the Government of India, or who have been convicted under any law, or who have taken part in activities against the sovereignty or integrity of India, or who have been dismissed from any government service.
  • Candidates with mental illness or mental disability.
  • A male candidate who has more than one living wife, and a woman candidate who has married a man who already has another living wife, are not eligible.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026?

  • Applying for the wrong post for which you do not meet the educational qualification.

  • Selecting the wrong category (General/SC/ST/OBC/EWS) - categories cannot be changed after submission; mismatched certificates lead to cancellation.
  • OBC (Backward Hindu 2A/2B/3A/3B) candidates from Creamy Layer applying under OBC reservation instead of General category.
  • Not uploading all mandatory documents at the time of online application - incomplete applications will be rejected outright.
  • Uploading blurred, illegible, or incorrect photographs, signatures, or certificates - leading to rejection at document verification stage.
  • Using an inactive or wrong mobile number and email ID - exam dates, interview schedules, and admit cards are communicated only through SMS and email.
  • Submitting multiple applications for the same post without following the proper Re-submit process - only the last valid application is considered and fees for others are forfeited.
  • Not reading the separate instructions for candidates who applied under the earlier notification (06.04.2026) - they must re-apply with their old registration number and need not pay fee again for the same post.
  • Not noting that each post requires a separate application and separate fee - applying for multiple posts with a single application/fee is not permitted.
  • Paying the fee through DD/Postal Order/Money Order or any offline mode - only online payment (Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI/Google Pay) is accepted.
  • Not keeping originals of all uploaded documents ready for verification - originals must be produced at the time of interview/verification.
  • Ignoring the minimum qualifying mark requirement: candidates must score a minimum of 85 out of 100 (or 200) in the written examination to qualify for the interview.

  • Applications must be submitted Online only at https://www.bellarydcc.bank.in; no other mode is accepted.

  • Candidates must mandatorily keep Kannada language proficiency - it is essential for all posts.
  • Information provided by candidates at the time of application regarding category, date of birth, educational qualification, age relaxation, etc., can only be for consideration purposes and will not be changed later; no request for change will be entertained afterward.
  • Incomplete applications, applications without photo/signature, or applications with incorrect information will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates must self-attest all documents and mandatorily upload them online.
  • Candidates must keep a printout of the submitted application for their own reference.

  • The Bank/external body reserves the right to advance, postpone, cancel, and change the rules of the recruitment process at any time without giving any reason.
  • The decision of the Bank's Board/Staff Recruitment Committee shall be final in all matters relating to recruitment; no correspondence will be entertained.
  • Candidates must serve a probation period of 2 years after selection.
  • Selected candidates will be provided security deposit and personal bond as informed by the Bank; they must sign a contract and pay the prescribed security deposit on joining.
  • This recruitment is subject to directions and orders of the Karnataka Government / High Court during the recruitment notification period.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • No correspondence regarding recruitment will be entertained from any candidate after the process has concluded.
